body:
The actual control owner had no stop path into its reviewed registry revocation, and gateway tool accounting still depended on injected budget ports. This draft adds explicit exact-binding `control.stopRun` with synchronous admission closure, cancellation and retained uncertainty; it also composes the existing dispatcher with PostgreSQL tool accounting through the canonical, hard-disabled gateway entry. Reentrant stop calls share one attempt. A fresh reservation UUID cannot replay a durable invocation slot, and model/tool UNKNOWN liabilities share the existing aggregate budget lock.

Both implementations have independent ACCEPT_SOURCE decisions. Trusted allocation validates the actual private0.2 manifest, exact limits and catalog digest. Fixed positive per-dispatch charges are conservative accounting, not measured provider cost or spending authority. New qualification migration0002 is explicit; the updated model ledger fails closed without it. No migration or database connection ran. Runtime packaging, trusted producer/Temporal recovery wiring and real-engine durability remain unqualified.

Integrated source: `1355c0ab9b0cb6162efef3b9d8ba4e3230a16ed9`, tree `37336310a7773e93464e15404fb7907ae34dc09a`. Report/evidence: `ef539182a0d406eef13bdb5816692c3fa27e8e29`, tree `39b22cbfe4f1f044cebf3abbdae618f67033ce6f`. Owner author/reviewer: `357251ee531bf4da9778116090ec22a4a8ee27a3` / `fd68053a0eb044d5031cabaa4c27a45d1337651b`; budget author/reviewer: `d58a2b1c51c43420fa64c1036c509ab14d872996` / `58714267430500f66565e0e73b7729555227c9f0`. Original branches and every negative result are preserved.

Validation: gateway139/139; independent budget29/29; Python accounting7/7 plus independent5/5; root244/244; public7/7 with generated-byte/type checks; owner26/26; Ubuntu301 checks; native packet7/7 plus independent58 checks/6 negative controls. All17 changed/new source files match the accepted author freezes. 3,209 of3,215 original files remain byte-identical; all23 original real-PG test bodies remain exact. Full whitespace check exits2 only on retained raw output/patch evidence; source/report whitespace passes. The unchanged legacy builder failure remains35 PASS/one Windows-owner ERROR and was not rerun.

Ubuntu evidence retains all54 obligations OPEN and all35 direct functions;22 positive vendor statements match exact observed versions, but signatures/snapshot/closure and unresolved vulnerabilities prevent an immutable executable candidate. The conditional existing-Python3.11.15 packet is independently accepted as source only: executable identity, distributor provenance, exact supervisor/receipt bounds and one-action authority are still required before a diagnostic. No native interpreter was executed.

Stacked on preserved PR14 `1e6d430cf9c239caca4198aea42a762f13021cd5`. G0 accepted/G1 OPEN/G2–G7 unentered. Scope remains139 originals,96 selected/43 deferred,14 bound unavailable/82 unmapped. Source connectivity stays off. No main merge, frontend/capirov2 edit, native/paid/provider/database execution, cloud build/push/launch, resource/credential/security/network/customer-data action occurred.
